regions.name: Saltwick Cove
regions.blurb: A sunset harbour where the drowned came crawling up the beach.

regions.name: The Fogbanks
regions.blurb: Ghost lights in the fog lead ships onto the rocks. Boss: the Wisp Mother.

regions.name: The Cutthroat Isles
regions.blurb: The Drowned Fleet sails again under rotten sails. Boss: Captain Barnaby Dread.

regions.name: Sunken Bell Reef
regions.blurb: A drowned town whose bells ring underwater. Boss: the Selkie Queen.

regions.name: Leviathan's Reach
regions.blurb: Serpent waters where the sea itself breathes. Boss: the Leviathan.

regions.name: The Maelstrom
regions.blurb: The great whirlpool at the end of the charts. Boss: the Kraken.
